meaning: M1-67 from afar: the bank's source-facing slices seen from the Sun and composited as the page composites them, laid on one plane fixed in the bank's frame, in the slices' own plane through its centre and across the line of sight from Earth. From Earth the plane shows what the layers draw; from elsewhere it turns and foreshortens as a fixed object, where a camera-facing billboard of the same picture spun as the camera orbited. It is a presentation of the layers, not a measurement.
